title: perf(canary): enhanced auto-detection & hysteresis rollout guards for latency/throughput regressions
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: Continuous performance canaries previously used fixed thresholds for latency and throughput which produced noisy rollouts on traffic spikes and mixed-tenant workloads. This PR implements an enhanced auto-detection algorithm with workload-aware baselining and a hysteresis-based rollout guard to reduce flapping and false positives. Changes: 1) services/perf-canary/detector.py - new adaptive baseline estimator (EWMA + percentile window) and KV-aware adjustments for sequence-heavy requests; 2) services/rolling/guard_manager.py - hysteresis state machine, multi-metric voting (p99 latency, tokens/sec throughput, error-rate) and automated rollback policy; 3) infra/deployment/canary_chart.yaml - new config knobs (baseline_window_secs, hysteresis_period_secs, vote_threshold); 4) integrations/linear/notify.py - additional context on detected regressions and suggested rollback reasons; 5) tests/perf/test_detector.py - unit + synthetic workload tests; 6) metrics/dashboards/perf_canary.yaml - new dashboards and alert rules; 7) docs/canary.md - updated guide and tuning section. Commits: feat(detector): adaptive baseline estimator; feat(guard): hysteresis state machine + rollback; test(perf): new synthetic workloads + CI integration. Motivation and impact: reduces noisy rollouts by ~65% in our internal canary experiments, correctly distinguishes transient spikes from true regressions, and enables safer automated canary rollouts for Dedicated and Hosted tiers. Testing: ran full perf-canary e2e pipeline on staging with 18k synthetic requests/min across mixed prompt lengths; regression detector triggered in 3 canaries and hysteresis prevented 2 premature rollbacks, the final rollback was executed automatically when sustained degradation persisted beyond hysteresis window. CI: build / unit / lint / perf-suite all passed; perf-suite required two reruns for a flaky network test which was addressed by increasing timeouts. Review convo: Ethan Park requested an explicit default for hysteresis_period_secs and a short explanation for the KV adjustment—addressed in second commit and docs; Sofia Alvarez requested dashboard links and approved after tests; Ravi Patel asked for release_notes and migration docs for on-prem customers—added docs/canary.md with upgrade notes. Rollout: merged to main and deployed to staging canary pool with gradual ramp; merge method: squash; merged_at: 2026-02-25. Related work: builds on ENG-1720 (initial canary infra) and PM-423 acceptance criteria for automated rollback. TODO: backport a minimal config to release/* for Dedicated customers, add canary telemetry tagging per-customer for billing, follow-up to tune vote thresholds per-model family.
release_notes: Improved canary auto-detection and rollout guards: adaptive baseline estimator, hysteresis-based guard to reduce false positives, multi-metric voting & automated rollback; config knobs added for tuning; docs updated with tuning guide and on-prem migration notes.
test_summary: End-to-end canary tests passed on staging; synthetic workload regression tests and perf-suite passed; two flaky perf tests rerun and fixed; observed ~65% reduction in noisy rollouts in internal A/B tests.
